claim: Dataset provides explicit shell sequences, mismatch parameters, growth results, and validation points.
Validated multi-component clusters include Na13@Rb32, K13@Cs42, and Ag13@Cu45.
MC-MC and MC-Ch1 mismatches cluster near ~0.04 and ~0.14 respectively.
Theory agrees with experimental mismatch values within small absolute error.
Conservative path dominates growth-path selection statistics.
